scoring_justification: Recompute partial pressures from public thermochemical data at hidden test temperatures and compare using relative error; dominance check of top species.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden test temperatures and expected partial pressures computed on-the-fly in the checker
hidden_assets.source_provenance: derived from the paper's thermochemical data and equilibrium equations (Table 1, reactions 1-10)
hidden_assets.generation_method: recomputed in checker by solving the same system of mass-action equations with scipy fsolve using the public constants
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The hidden test points are a subset of the temperature range 1000-1500 K; the expected pressures are computed from the same public data as the task, guaranteeing correctness and consistency with the paper's reported curves.

outputs.description: Equilibrium partial pressures of 13 gaseous species as a function of temperature for the upper and lower phase boundaries of NbO2 at total pressure 1 atm and Cl/Te balance ratio 4. The checker recomputes the expected pressures from the same public thermochemical data and constraints at hidden test temperatures, then compares them using relative errors.

output_contract.notes: The task requires solving a nonlinear system of mass-action equations with 10 reactions. The dominant species verification is part of the scoring. No hidden gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
